name: Automações
description: One automation model (ADR-0031): Apple Home, Atelier and Butler automations — list, explain any of them in plain Portuguese, their health (what is broken and why, from the Apple Home structure history: removed accessories, likely replacements, lost actions, duplicates, conflicts — admins), switch one on/off (admin's confirmation), and propose a new one or a change from what an admin asked (stored as a proposal; only the admin's Aceitar in the app makes it live).
